main.name: Hashirr Lukmahn
main.description: Hi everyone! Welcome to my website. Feel free to scroll down and browse around to learn more about my work, projects, and background!
main.bio: Hello! I'm Hashirr, a Software Engineer at Scalekit in San Francisco, where I build authentication infrastructure and developer tooling for B2B SaaS and AI-native applications. Originally from Singapore, I graduated from the University of Colorado Boulder with a B.S. in Computer Science. I'm drawn to infrastructure and platform engineering, the kind of problems where good design decisions compound over time, and I love experimenting with AI frameworks and agents in my free time.
main.bio2: Beyond my technical work, I'm an avid badminton player and enjoy exploring the great outdoors through hiking. Whether I'm building new projects or picking up new hobbies, I'm always looking for ways to challenge myself and grow both personally and professionally.
main.bio3: Welcome to my personal website, where I share my projects, interests, and insights into the exciting world of technology!

education.description: My academic journey at CU Boulder blended Computer Science with Business and Leadership studies, giving me a well-rounded foundation for the tech industry. In Computer Science, I progressed from core courses like Principles of Programming Languages (CSCI 3155) and Computer Systems (CSCI 2400) to advanced topics, and I graduated with a 3.51 GPA and Dean's List honors (Fall 2023, Spring 2024, Fall 2024). projects.title: Autonomous Social Media Agent
projects.description: An unsupervised AI agent that grows a Bluesky account by autonomously creating and posting software-engineering memes. Running 24/7 on Railway, it abstracts trending themes from reference accounts and tech news, generates memes, runs a four-layer safety review, and posts during peak engagement windows, with an engagement-scoring feedback loop and circuit breakers that keep it resilient across multiple external APIs.
projects.technologies: TypeScript, Claude Sonnet 4.6 & Haiku 4.5, Drizzle ORM, PostgreSQL, Redis, Apify, Mem0, Railway

projects.title: CoffeeDesk CRM MCP Server
projects.description: A Model Context Protocol server that securely bridges AI assistants like Claude Desktop with a CRM's API. It exposes CRUD tools for projects, tasks, workspace members, and activities, secured with OAuth 2.0 and scope-based access control via Scalekit, with multi-tenant, organization-level data isolation and dynamic client registration. Built during my time at Scalekit.
projects.technologies: TypeScript, Node.js, Express.js, OAuth 2.0, Scalekit, Model Context Protocol

projects.title: Coffee Desk: B2B SaaS Demo
projects.description: A full-stack, multi-tenant B2B application template showcasing production-ready project and task management on top of Scalekit's authentication platform. Features automatic per-organization data isolation, role-based access control, SSO (SAML/OIDC) and social/passwordless auth, a real-time metrics dashboard, and organization-scoped REST APIs. Built during my time at Scalekit.
projects.technologies: Go (Gin, GORM), React, TypeScript, Vite, PostgreSQL, Docker, GCP Cloud Run, Scalekit

projects.title: Meetstream Gmail MCP Server
projects.description: A Model Context Protocol server that lets AI agents and clients like Claude Desktop securely access Gmail through OAuth 2.0 and Scalekit's Agent Actions framework. It provides eight Gmail tools (reading emails, managing threads, fetching contacts, and downloading attachments) using two-layer authentication so tools can be called without exposing direct API credentials. Built during my time at Scalekit.
projects.technologies: TypeScript, Node.js, Express.js, OAuth 2.0, Scalekit Agent Actions, Model Context Protocol, Docker
